description:
[Trading Data API] Transaction lookup by hash: status (success/reverted/pending), block, from/to, value, nonce, gas used, effective gas price and log count.

**Example:** `/v1/chain-tx?hash=0x...&chain=base`

Use when you need the status and details of a transaction by hash. Not for account-level data (use chain_balance or chain_nonce).

Behavior: read-only. Priced via x402 (USDC on Base) or free with WICKEDAPI_API_KEY; with neither, you get HTTP 402 with the decoded price in payment_required (a price quote, not a failure).

chain.description: Optional. ethereum, base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon (default base).

name: chain_tx
